title: Mayer--Vietoris gluing of bounded flat counit presentations
statement: Let p:Y -> B be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, let B and A be affine schemes and g:A -> B. Let U be a quasi-compact open of Y and V an affine open. Assume StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g holds for U, V and U intersect V. Then it holds for U union V. Each hypothesis applies to every relatively flat quasi-coherent module on that open; it supplies its own bounded flat base-complex presentation and canonical counit equation. It does not assume the presentation on the union.

source.place: Tag 0DJ9, relative Mayer--Vietoris induction step; Tag 08DR; original model proof Steps 2--3

proof.text: For each relatively flat quasi-coherent module N on U union V, apply the per-module Mayer--Vietoris presentation gluing theorem to obtain its presentation on the union.

theorem standardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen_union
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    [IsAffine B] [IsAffine A] (g : A ⟶ B) (U V : Y.Opens)

    (hPU : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g U)
    (hPV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g V)
    (hPUV : StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g (U ⊓ V)) :
    StandardSingleFlatCounitOnOpen p g (U ⊔ V)
